children: Stifel reiterated a Buy rating and $350 price target on Marvell Technology

, the data center chip designer, after a booth meeting with executives at the ECOC 2026 optical communications conference in Malaga, Spain. Marvell told the firm it expects to sample 2nm products at the end of 2026, with production ramping in the second half of 2027 across PAM4 and coherent/coherent-lite modulation. Marvell shares were down 0.58% in premarket.

Management's pitch focused on supply, arguing that securing 2nm capacity, not just access to the node, is what sets it apart. Stifel also flagged pluggable optical modules as potentially underappreciated, with unit volume expectations rising across scale-up, scale-out and scale-across networks.

Separately, Marvell has expanded its silicon-germanium capacity with GlobalFoundries (GFS) to support its lead in transimpedance amplifiers. Management also sees its XPU Attach business, the components that connect to custom AI processors, as a potentially bigger opportunity than the processor market itself, a case it may lay out at its October 6 Investor Day.

title: Stifel Backs Marvell's $350 Target on 2nm Capacity Edge
